submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements were near zero (≤0.00035%), at about the noise floor. The highest was index 0 (Sb 0.031). At that end, XRD shows a crystalline fluorite-type Bi2O3 phase (best match mp-23195, similarity 0.81). Going toward higher Sb, that phase's peaks get weaker; by Sb 0.66 only FTO substrate peaks remain, which suggests the film is amorphous. No new ternary phase (BiSbO4 or Bi3SbO7) showed up at 0.27 or 0.40. So the most crystalline, Bi-rich end is the most plausible active region.
